statement: Entanglement without distillable secret key. Constructs an entangled state on $`\mathbb C^{10}\otimes\mathbb C^{10}`$ with zero distillable secret key for the specified local-instrument protocols that complete almost surely. These allow joint local processing and authenticated two-way public communication, with no other shared private resource and an eavesdropper holding the input purification and public record. A trace-preserving PPT channel on $`M_{21}(\mathbb C)`$ whose square is not entanglement breaking disproves Christandl's PPT-square conjecture.
